DECLARATION made as of Fbruary, 19, 2013 (this "Declaration"), by 101w87
OWNER LLC, a New York limited liability company having its principal office at c/o Paul
Hastings LLP, 75 East 55th Street, New York, NY 10022 (“Owner").
WITNESSETH:
WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain vacant land (the "Townhouse Land")
located in the Borough of Manhattan, County and State of New York, being Tax Lot 129 of
Block 1218 as shown on the Tax Map of the City of New York, together with any future
improvements thereon (said improvements, together with any additions or replacements thereof,
being herein referred to as the “Townhouse Building"; the Townhouse Land together with the
Townhouse Building being herein referred to as the "Townhouse Property"), and being more
particularly described in Exhibit A attached hereto;
WHEREAS, Owner is also the owner of certain land (the "Developer's Land") located
in the Borough of Manhattan, County and State of New York, known by the street address 101
West 87th Street, New York, New York, and being Tax Lot 29 of Block 1218 as shown on the
Tax Map of the City of New York, together with any improvements thereon (said improvements,
together with any additions or replacements thereof, being herein referred to as “Developer's
Building"; Developer's Land together with Developer's Building, including Developer's New
Building (as hereinafter defined), being herein referred to as “Developer's Property"), and
being more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 attached hereto;
WHEREAS, the Townhouse Land and Developer's Land presently comprise a single
"zoning lot" (the “Zoning Lot") pursuant to and as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the
Zoning Resolution of The City of New York, effective December 15, 1961 (as amended to the
date hereof, the “Zoning Resolution");
WHEREAS, Owner is simultaneously herewith executing, delivering and recording a
Zoning Lot Description and Ownership Statement, dated as of the date hereof, which states that
the Townhouse Land and Developer's Land constitute the single Zoning Lot;
WHEREAS, Owner intends to develop on Developer's Property (Owner, as developer of
Developer's Property, is hereinafter referred to as the “Developer") Developer's New Building;
WHEREAS, Owner is retaining, for the benefit of the Townhouse Land, 6,199 square
feet of "Floor Area Development Rights," as defined below, appurtenant to the Zoning Lot (the
"Retained Floor Area,"as defined below);
WHEREAS, Owner has decided that Developer shall own all Floor Area Development
Rights now or in the future appurtenant to the Zoning Lot that are in excess of the Retained Floor
Area (“"Developer's Floor Area," as defined below);
WHEREAS, as owner of Developer's Floor Area, Developer shall be permitted to
